anime.title: 86 Eighty-Six
anime.editorsTake: Its strongest appeal is the way social division, character growth, and worldbuilding reinforce each other. The contrast between those safely removed from war and those forced to live it gives Lena's growth real weight, while the world expands gradually instead of being explained all at once. Its emotional peaks land hardest when story, music, and direction release tension that has been building for a long time.
